worked_derivation: One corporate ownership category aggregates600000+400000. Ordinary insurance=250000; initial uninsured=750000.
Sunday shortfall=250000-200000=50000; Monday bridge repayment=50500.00. Initial guaranteed Monday access=250000; Monday obligations=750000+100000+50500.00, so guaranteed funding deficit=650500.00.
After protection, Monday access=1000000; ending cash=1000000-750000-100000-50500.00=99500.00. No deposit cash was assumed available Sunday.

The initial statement gives neither an exact uninsured dividend nor exact total recovery. An advance of50000 versus100000 paid later that week changes nonguaranteed funding without changing the stated insured bound or promising Monday access. Depositor protection does not extend to shareholders.
